reviewType: Independent source review with narrow read-only pure graph/isolated-JS-VM probes. No native/helper, MCP, GUI, build or test-suite execution; no source edits.
scope: New standalone receipt semantic/private-blob validator and pure Node argument preparation helper only. They are not connected to the product receipt reader, Node durable storage, dispatcher or provider workflow.
scopeSeparation: Prior SDK context freeze (69 sources/3 artifacts and its independent checks) belongs to its earlier scope. This report neither revalidates nor extends that acceptance to these changed/new modules or refreshed build artifacts.

findings.original: Accepted plus successful SDK terminal without any top-level tool entry/terminal produced effects_unknown=false.
findings.correction: Successful transport with missing/incomplete top-level wrapper keeps lifecycle_unknown=true. Explicit pre-wrapper non-dispatch may complete the SDK lifecycle without inventing a wrapper.
findings.verification: Current source inspected. Pure final graph probe returns lifecycle_unknown=true for the original two-row counterexample.

findings.original: A child tool terminal, deeper child entry or native fact could appear after an already terminal ancestor and still complete the graph.
findings.correction: Every new child entry, child tool terminal and native phase walks the complete ancestor chain and requires all ancestors open.
findings.verification: Current source and new ancestor counterexamples inspected. Original late-child-terminal pure probe now rejects.

findings.original: Matching-hash native snapshots could contain reserved receipt, raw LF or exceed 65536 bytes, though those frames cannot reach native handler entry. Features could carry a noncanonical extra-field envelope.
findings.correction: Exact native snapshots require one nonempty LF-free frame <=65536 bytes, no reserved top-level receipt, strict ID/version, exact receipt control binding, and exact three-field session.features envelope.
findings.verification: Current source and hash-valid-but-impossible snapshot tests inspected; existing validation-v8 log includes all 24 current pure graph/private-disk cases passing.

findings.original: A complete tool/native execution graph could be paired with root outcome=not_dispatched and still validate.
findings.correction: Root not_dispatched is rejected if any tool_entered already exists, matching the RequestExecution writer contract rather than guessing safety from missing flags.
findings.verification: Current source and both continued-native/refused-native contradiction tests inspected. Original complete-graph pure counterexample now rejects.

findings.original: Array.prototype/Object.prototype toJSON could run during preparation or after an async boundary, yielding bytes inconsistent with the prepared fingerprint despite frozen arrays.
findings.correction: Copied objects, arrays and returned preparation object have null prototypes. Arrays are built and fingerprinted by index; no push or iterator dependency remains. Frozen snapshots may be safely prepared again.
findings.verification: Isolated VM reproduced old hookCalls=1/digest mismatch and post-freeze reserialization drift. The current-source pure VM probe returns hookCalls=0, matching decoded semantic digest, stable serialization and stable repeated preparation with both inherited hooks installed.

semanticAssessment.lifecycle_unknown: Describes missing/incomplete lifecycle evidence and expected wrapper closure; it does not claim application consumption or absence of side effects.
semanticAssessment.reported_unknown_operation_ids: Reports only explicitly present outcome=unknown separately from lifecycle completeness.
semanticAssessment.terminal_flags: Preserves only actual reported fields. Complete ok=false without action_sent/outcome does not acquire invented non-dispatch, rollback or safety flags.
semanticAssessment.replay_safe: Not emitted and not derivable from lifecycle_unknown=false or handler/root terminal.

descriptorAssessment: Reads committed journal prefix first and validates graph/typed identities rather than trusting summary booleans.
Argument reference names derive from validated operation IDs; total referenced bytes are bounded.
Leaf opens use NONBLOCK and NOFOLLOW; owned single-link regular file checks, expected size, device/inode/mtime stability, exact read extent and SHA256 are checked.

Every leaf descriptor closes in finally before JSON/semantic decoding; parent and invocation directory descriptors also close in outer finally. No descriptor leak was identified on the reviewed ordinary exception paths.

Accepted private blob content is fingerprinted and compared with received semantic digest. Native snapshots are parsed and checked against recorded frame/control identity. Private blob contents are not returned.
pureProbeEvidenceTreatment: Original narrow probe outputs are available in this chat tool trace. No standalone original-stdout artifact was captured by reviewer; the facts above are summaries, not reconstructed raw logs. No reviewer private-disk fixture test or native operation was run.

existingParentDevelopmentEvidence.historicalAttempts: validation-v1 failed one expectation that optional tool_terminal.ok must be rejected; corrected semantics retains unknown instead. v2=10, v3=16, v4/v5=18, v6=21, and v7/v8 further refine transport/root contradictions; all original logs are retained byte-for-byte. v4 mixed explicit outcome unknown into lifecycle uncertainty; current two-axis semantics is distinct.
existingParentDevelopmentEvidence.limitations: These are parent pure development runs, not new independent runtime acceptance or whole-feature gate closure.

outcome: All five actionable findings identified in this review are closed in the current standalone drafts. No remaining actionable source finding identified within the reviewed scope.
mandatoryIntegrationLimits: Product execution_receipt still must explicitly opt into validated semantics; legacy incomplete/request_terminal summaries alone are not equivalent to semantic validation.

A complete observed graph is not proof that every tool-specific native/one-shot effect layer was covered. Future gate consumers must check the required backend/receipt scope as well as worker, tool and actual-argument binding.

Node preparation helper must be invoked after approval/restoration at the actual bridge boundary, and that same frozen snapshot/json must feed durable preparation and transmission. No later code may substitute mutable original arguments.
Node durable preparation, provider direct/proxy activation, result persistence and restart reconciliation are unfinished.
Retention/global-space management, single-request helper coverage and source-bound end-to-end fault-window acceptance remain open.
Held-state fault qualification remains separate and requires independent qualified rescue.
automaticLockRestoration: Only after whole P5 acceptance; no locking settings inspected or changed.
